description: IESopt provides modular optimisation of integrated energy systems using abstract asset building blocks. Its Julia core is accompanied by a Python wrapper and configuration-driven model definitions. The provider is AIT Austrian Institute of Technology. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository explicitly states MIT. Solver choices and input-data permissions require separate consideration. Limitations: The provider describes continuing maintenance. This review did not test solver performance, supported formulations or wrapper compatibility. For simulation it supports coupled energy-carrier planning and operation optimisation. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers IESopt.
